definition.definition: Fraction of configured seeded mutants rejected by recognized assertions or the pinned Pester dependency-parameter mismatch after the identical submission passes the reference. Unrecognized test failures, discovery failures and infrastructure failures remain unmeasured.

definition.title: Reference correctness

definition.definition: Reference correctness and detection of every configured seeded mutant must both hold. This version accepts recognized assertions and the pinned Pester dependency-parameter mismatch; it never credits reference failures or unclassified execution failures.
